01 / THE WORKSHOP

Three fields.
One shared future.

GeniSys brings researchers, practitioners, and students together to rethink how AI models, computing systems, and networks work together.

Exploring Synergy among Next-Generation AI, Systems, and Networking for a Sustainable Future is a one-day workshop at Rice University. Join a conversation about the infrastructure behind scalable, reliable, secure, and energy-efficient AI.

Invited talksResearch posters & demosPanels & discussionStudent lightning talks

On-campus workshop with hybrid participation planned. The date, room, and participation details will be announced.

WHAT TO BRING

A question. A result.
A conversation starter.

Possible poster topics include the areas below. Work spanning several layers of the AI stack is especially relevant to the workshop.

  • Large-scale AI training and efficient inference
  • GPU and heterogeneous system optimization
  • Networking for distributed AI workloads
  • Reliable and resilient AI infrastructure
  • Energy-efficient and sustainable computing
  • Secure AI deployment and cross-layer co-design
Can I present work that is already published?

Yes. Previously published work is welcome, alongside recent research. The poster session is an opportunity to share your findings with the GeniSys community and discuss new directions.

What should I prepare?

Start with a clear research question, your approach, and the results or insights you would like to discuss. Submit your research poster using the Box upload link above. File requirements and poster dimensions will be announced.

Can I participate remotely?

The workshop plans to support hybrid participation. Remote poster presentation arrangements have not yet been announced.
